definition_2_2:
theorem definition_2_2 (V : Set E) : Convex ℝ V ↔
    ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ y ∈ V, ∀ λ : ℝ, 0 < λ → λ < 1 → λ • x + (1 - λ) • y ∈ V
convex_effectiveDomain:
theorem convex_effectiveDomain (f : E → EReal) (hf : IsConvexExtended f) :
    Convex ℝ (effectiveDomain f)
effectiveDomain_indicator:
theorem effectiveDomain_indicator (V : Set E) :
    effectiveDomain (extendedIndicator V) = V
convex_indicator_iff:
theorem convex_indicator_iff (V : Set E) :
    IsConvexExtended (extendedIndicator V) ↔ Convex ℝ V
realEpigraph_toReal:
theorem realEpigraph_toReal (f : E → EReal) (hbot : ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊥) :
    realEpigraph f = {p : E × ℝ | p.1 ∈ effectiveDomain f ∧ (f p.1).toReal ≤ p.2}
convexExtended_iff_toReal:
theorem convexExtended_iff_toReal (f : E → EReal) (hbot : ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊥) :
    IsConvexExtended f ↔ ConvexOn ℝ (effectiveDomain f) (fun x => (f x).toReal)
theorem_2_4:
theorem theorem_2_4 (f : E → EReal) (hbot : ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊥)
    (hdom : Convex ℝ (effectiveDomain f)) :
    IsConvexExtended f ↔ ∀ x ∈ effectiveDomain f, ∀ y ∈ effectiveDomain f,
      ∀ λ : ℝ, 0 < λ → λ < 1 →
        f (λ • x + (1 - λ) • y) ≤ (λ : EReal) * f x + ((1 - λ : ℝ) : EReal) * f y
